content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in early 2025, especially after mid-2024 peaks; adjust downward by 1–3% for recent periods.
- Overestimates after sharp price spikes (e.g., 83+), often overshooting by 5–10% in the immediate aftermath; cap forecasts at 10% below peak if spike >80.
- Shows persistent mean reversion bias: forecasts drift downward too aggressively after 75+; add 2–5% upward bias for 3–5 consecutive days above 75.
- Underreacts to downward momentum; when true price drops >5% from prior day, model should reduce forecast by 2–4% more aggressively.
- Forecasts for 30-day horizon are too optimistic in early 2025; apply 3–5% downward adjustment for forecasts with >20% above historical mean.
